datasets.title: Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba Roads (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 1.3 thousand km of roads in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 97 % of the total road length in the dataset region. The average age of data for the region is 2 years ( Last edited 3 months ago ) and 40% of roads were added or updated in the last 6 months. Read about what this summary means : indicators , metrics This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching ( Learn what tags means here ) : tags['highway'] IS NOT NULL Features may have these attributes: name name:en highway surface smoothness width lanes oneway bridge layer source This dataset is one of many OpenStreetMap exports on HDX . See the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team website for more information.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/hotosm_bes_roads]
datasets.details: OpenStreetMap data is crowd sourced and cannot be considered to be exhaustive

lineage.description: Road network data was collected through OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information contributions and processed by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team's raw data API. The dataset represents approximately 1.3 thousand km of roads with 97% estimated coverage of total road length in the region, with attributes including highway classification, surface type, width, lanes, and bridge indicators.
